fusions.name: Warm Mulch
fusions.desc: A ring of spores deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Herd Weight
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Barn
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Mossy Calf
fusions.desc: A bonded calf grazes at your side, butting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each kill it makes restores 3 health to you.
